newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Delifrance Asia offers 45.16 million shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Delifrance Asia offers 45.16 million shares in IPO.

text.p: Delifrance Asia Ltd said on Monday it will offer 45.16 million shares in an initial public offer (IPO) at a price of Singapore $0.78 each.
Delifrance, a French cafe and bakeries chain, said there would be no placement tranche in the share offering.
The Delifrance offer represents 25 percent of its enlarged share capital. Up to 10 percent of the shares would be reserved for management, staff and business associates of the group.
The offer will close on October 17 and trading will begin on a when-issued basis on Singapore's main board on October 21.
Delifrance said the share price represents an historical price-earnings ratio of 17.26 times.
The offer is managed and underwritten by OCBC Bank.
